```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Load Libraries

library(CVXR)

```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
project_dir <- getwd()

knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = normalizePath(
    file.path(project_dir, "..", "..")
  )
)
```

This workflow uses a temporal holdout: observations from 2020–2024 are used to
fit each candidate ridge model, and the 2025 province observations are held out
to select \(\lambda\) by prediction RMSE. The 2025 national GDP constraint is
not used during lambda selection, so the holdout measures predictions not
calibrated to a known 2025 aggregate. After selecting \(\lambda\), the model is
refit on all years for the level-2 prediction step.

### Load dataset
```{r}
# Regression Dataset
regression_data <- read.csv("data/training_data/regression_dataset.csv")

regression_data$population <- regression_data$population * 1000

# Prediction Dataset
prediction_data <- read.csv("data/training_data/prediction_dataset.csv")

# National GDP totals used to constrain the regression fit
constrained_data <- read.csv("data/_vnm_indicators/vnm_level0_gdp.csv")

# Provincial GRDP per-capita targets used to calibrate 2025 level-2 predictions
provincial_grdp_data <- read.csv(
  "data/_vnm_indicators/vnm_GRDPpc.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Provincial population totals (thousands) used as the aggregation constraint
provincial_population_data <- read.csv(
  "data/_vnm_indicators/vnm_population.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)
```


### Preliminaries
Supposed:

* \(y \in \mathbb{R}^n\): observed outcome vector. That is, `grdp_per_capita`.
* \(x_i \in \mathbb{R}^3\): standardized explanatory variables for observation \(i\): `mean_radiance`, `population`, and `pixel_count`.
* \(\alpha_t \in \mathbb{R}\): year-specific intercept for year \(t\).
* \(\beta \in \mathbb{R}^3\): shared slopes for the explanatory variables.
* \(a_t \in \mathbb{R}\): specified national GDP total for year \(t\).

Candidate models have separate, unpenalized intercepts for each training year
and shared ridge-penalized slopes for standardized explanatory variables.
National GDP constraints are imposed only on training years. Candidate
predictions are evaluated on the untouched 2025 province outcomes using holdout
RMSE and \(R^2\).

```{r}
# Define the temporal split and scale features using training years only.
training_years <- 2020:2024
holdout_year <- 2025
training_data <- regression_data[
  regression_data$year %in% training_years,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
holdout_data <- regression_data[
  regression_data$year == holdout_year,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
if (nrow(training_data) == 0 || nrow(holdout_data) == 0) {
  stop("Training data must include 2020-2024 and holdout data must include 2025.")
}
if (!setequal(sort(unique(training_data$year)), training_years)) {
  stop("Training data must contain observations for every year from 2020 to 2024.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(training_data[c("province", "year")]) ||
    anyDuplicated(holdout_data$province)) {
  stop("Training province-year rows and 2025 holdout provinces must be unique.")
}

y_train <- training_data$grdp_per_capita
y_holdout <- holdout_data$grdp_per_capita
feature_columns <- c("mean_radiance", "population", "pixel_count")
feature_means <- vapply(training_data[feature_columns], mean, numeric(1))
feature_sds <- vapply(training_data[feature_columns], sd, numeric(1))
if (any(!is.finite(feature_sds)) || any(feature_sds == 0)) {
  stop("Training predictors must have finite, non-zero standard deviations.")
}

scaled_training <- scale(
  training_data[feature_columns],
  center = feature_means,
  scale = feature_sds
)
scaled_holdout <- scale(
  holdout_data[feature_columns],
  center = feature_means,
  scale = feature_sds
)
training_data$year_factor <- factor(training_data$year, levels = training_years)
X_train <- cbind(
  model.matrix(~ 0 + year_factor, data = training_data),
  as.matrix(scaled_training)
)
time_extrapolation_weights <-
  rep(1 / length(training_years), length(training_years)) +
  (holdout_year - mean(training_years)) *
    (training_years - mean(training_years)) /
    sum((training_years - mean(training_years))^2)
X_holdout <- cbind(
  matrix(
    rep(time_extrapolation_weights, each = nrow(holdout_data)),
    nrow = nrow(holdout_data)
  ),
  as.matrix(scaled_holdout)
)
if (ncol(X_train) != ncol(X_holdout)) {
  stop("Training and holdout design matrices have different column counts.")
}

training_population <- training_data$population
training_year <- training_data$year
target_gdp_training <- constrained_data$gdp[
  match(training_years, constrained_data$year)
]
if (anyNA(target_gdp_training) || any(!is.finite(target_gdp_training))) {
  stop("Missing or non-finite national GDP target for a training year.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(constrained_data$year[
  constrained_data$year %in% training_years
])) {
  stop("National GDP data contains duplicate targets for a training year.")
}
```

### Optimization problem

For each candidate \(\lambda\), fit observations from 2020–2024 subject to
national GDP constraints for those training years:
\[
\boxed{
\begin{aligned}
\min_{\alpha,\beta}\quad &
\|y-\hat y\|_2^2+\lambda\|\beta\|_2^2\\
\text{s.t.}\quad
&\sum_{i:\,\mathrm{year}_i=t} P_i\hat y_i=a_t,
\quad t\in\{2020,\ldots,2024\},\\
&\hat y_{it}=\alpha_t+x_i^\top\beta,
\quad t\in\{2020,\ldots,2024\},\\
\quad \lambda\ge 0.
\end{aligned}
}
\]
Only the standardized feature slopes \(\beta\) are penalized; the yearly
intercepts remain unpenalized. The 2025 intercept is predicted by linearly
extrapolating the fitted 2020–2024 intercepts; this extrapolation uses training
years only.


```{r}
# Evaluate a logarithmic penalty grid from 10^-3 through 10^3 on the holdout.
lambda_grid <- 10^seq(-3, 3, length.out = 61)
training_parameter_count <- ncol(X_train)
feature_parameter_indices <- (length(training_years) + 1):training_parameter_count
holdout_coefficients <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = training_parameter_count,
  ncol = length(lambda_grid)
)
holdout_predictions <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(y_holdout),
  ncol = length(lambda_grid)
)
holdout_status <- character(length(lambda_grid))

for (lambda_index in seq_along(lambda_grid)) {
  ridge_beta <- Variable(training_parameter_count)
  ridge_fitted <- X_train %*% ridge_beta

  training_constraints <- lapply(seq_along(training_years), function(i) {
    idx <- which(training_year == training_years[i])
    sum_entries(training_population[idx] * ridge_fitted[idx]) /
      target_gdp_training[i] == 1
  })

  ridge_problem <- Problem(
    Minimize(
      sum_squares(y_train - ridge_fitted) +
        lambda_grid[lambda_index] *
        sum_squares(ridge_beta[feature_parameter_indices])
    ),
    training_constraints
  )
  ridge_result <- solve(ridge_problem, solver = "CLARABEL")
  holdout_status[lambda_index] <- ridge_result$status
  if (!ridge_result$status %in% c("optimal", "optimal_inaccurate")) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Training ridge fit failed for lambda=%g with solver status: %s",
      lambda_grid[lambda_index],
      ridge_result$status
    ))
  }

  holdout_coefficients[, lambda_index] <- as.numeric(value(ridge_beta))
  holdout_predictions[, lambda_index] <-
    as.vector(X_holdout %*% holdout_coefficients[, lambda_index])
}

holdout_total_sum_squares <- sum((y_holdout - mean(y_holdout))^2)
if (holdout_total_sum_squares == 0) {
  stop("Cannot compute holdout R-squared because 2025 outcomes have zero variance.")
}

lambda_results <- data.frame(
  lambda = lambda_grid,
  holdout_RMSE = apply(holdout_predictions, 2, function(fit) {
    sqrt(mean((y_holdout - fit)^2))
  }),
  holdout_R_squared = apply(holdout_predictions, 2, function(fit) {
    1 - sum((y_holdout - fit)^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares
  }),
  solver_status = holdout_status
)
write.csv(
  lambda_results,
  "data/predicted_data/ridge_lambda_grid_metrics.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

selected_index <- which.min(lambda_results$holdout_RMSE)
selected_lambda <- lambda_results$lambda[selected_index]
best_holdout_predictions <- holdout_predictions[, selected_index]
holdout_residuals <- y_holdout - best_holdout_predictions

cat(sprintf("Selected lambda by minimum 2025 holdout RMSE: %.8g\n", selected_lambda))
print(lambda_results, row.names = FALSE)

lambda_plot_path <- "figures/ridge_lambda_grid_metrics.png"
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
grDevices::png(lambda_plot_path, width = 2000, height = 900, res = 160)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1))
plot(
  lambda_results$lambda,
  lambda_results$holdout_RMSE,
  type = "l",
  col = "#0072B2",
  xlab = expression(lambda),
  ylab = "2025 holdout RMSE",
  main = "Ridge penalty grid: 2025 RMSE",
  log = "x",
  yaxt = "n"
)
points(
  lambda_results$lambda,
  lambda_results$holdout_RMSE,
  pch = 19,
  col = ifelse(seq_len(nrow(lambda_results)) == selected_index, "#D55E00", "#0072B2")
)
rmse_ticks <- pretty(lambda_results$holdout_RMSE)
axis(2, at = rmse_ticks, labels = formatC(rmse_ticks, format = "f", digits = 8))
abline(v = selected_lambda, lty = 2, col = "#D55E00")
plot(
  lambda_results$lambda,
  lambda_results$holdout_R_squared,
  type = "l",
  col = "#0072B2",
  xlab = expression(lambda),
  ylab = expression("2025 holdout " * R^2),
  main = "Ridge penalty grid: 2025 R-squared",
  log = "x",
  yaxt = "n"
)
points(
  lambda_results$lambda,
  lambda_results$holdout_R_squared,
  pch = 19,
  col = ifelse(seq_len(nrow(lambda_results)) == selected_index, "#D55E00", "#0072B2")
)
r_squared_ticks <- pretty(lambda_results$holdout_R_squared)
axis(
  2,
  at = r_squared_ticks,
  labels = formatC(r_squared_ticks, format = "f", digits = 8)
)
abline(v = selected_lambda, lty = 2, col = "#D55E00")
grDevices::dev.off()
knitr::include_graphics(lambda_plot_path)
```

### Refit selected model on all years

After selecting \(\lambda\) using only 2025 holdout RMSE, refit the constrained
ridge model on all available years. This final fit is used only to generate the
2025 level-2 predictions; the reported holdout metrics above remain predictions
from models trained on 2020–2024.

```{r}
years <- sort(unique(regression_data$year))
regression_data$year_factor <- factor(regression_data$year, levels = years)
scaled_all <- scale(
  regression_data[feature_columns],
  center = feature_means,
  scale = feature_sds
)
X <- cbind(
  model.matrix(~ 0 + year_factor, data = regression_data),
  as.matrix(scaled_all)
)
y <- regression_data$grdp_per_capita
year <- regression_data$year
population <- regression_data$population
p <- ncol(X)
feature_parameter_indices <- (length(years) + 1):p
target_gdp <- constrained_data$gdp[match(years, constrained_data$year)]
if (anyNA(target_gdp) || any(!is.finite(target_gdp))) {
  stop("Missing or non-finite national GDP target for a refit year.")
}

final_beta <- Variable(p)
final_fitted <- X %*% final_beta
final_constraints <- lapply(seq_along(years), function(i) {
  idx <- which(year == years[i])
  sum_entries(population[idx] * final_fitted[idx]) / target_gdp[i] == 1
})
final_problem <- Problem(
  Minimize(
    sum_squares(y - final_fitted) +
      selected_lambda * sum_squares(final_beta[feature_parameter_indices])
  ),
  final_constraints
)
final_result <- solve(final_problem, solver = "CLARABEL")
if (!final_result$status %in% c("optimal", "optimal_inaccurate")) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Final all-years ridge refit failed with solver status: %s",
    final_result$status
  ))
}
beta_hat <- as.numeric(value(final_beta))
predictions <- as.vector(X %*% beta_hat)
final_constraint_check <- data.frame(
  year = years,
  predicted_total = vapply(years, function(t) {
    idx <- which(year == t)
    sum(population[idx] * predictions[idx])
  }, numeric(1)),
  target_total = target_gdp
)
final_constraint_check$difference <-
  final_constraint_check$predicted_total -
  final_constraint_check$target_total
if (any(abs(final_constraint_check$difference) >
        1e-8 * pmax(abs(final_constraint_check$target_total), 1))) {
  stop("Final ridge refit does not satisfy the annual GDP constraints.")
}
print(final_constraint_check, row.names = FALSE)
```

### Statistical Summary

The final model comparison and lambda selection use only 2025 holdout
predictions from models fitted on 2020–2024. Holdout \(R^2\) is computed
relative to the mean of the observed 2025 provinces. The OLS model is included
as an unconstrained reference and uses the same training features.

```{r}
ols_fit <- lm.fit(x = X_train, y = y_train)
ols_holdout_predictions <- as.vector(X_holdout %*% ols_fit$coefficients)
ols_holdout_residuals <- y_holdout - ols_holdout_predictions
ridge_residuals <- holdout_residuals

holdout_model_stats <- data.frame(
  model = c("Constrained ridge", "Ordinary least squares reference"),
  R_squared = c(
    1 - sum(ridge_residuals^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares,
    1 - sum(ols_holdout_residuals^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    sqrt(mean(ridge_residuals^2)),
    sqrt(mean(ols_holdout_residuals^2))
  )
)

print(holdout_model_stats, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf(
  "Selected lambda: %.8g; 2025 holdout RMSE: %.6f; holdout R-squared: %.6f\n",
  selected_lambda,
  holdout_model_stats$RMSE[1],
  holdout_model_stats$R_squared[1]
))

ridge_rmse <- holdout_model_stats$RMSE[1]
ols_rmse <- holdout_model_stats$RMSE[2]
cat(sprintf(
  "2025 holdout ridge RMSE (lambda=%.8g) is %.6f GRDP-per-capita units (%.2f%%) %s than OLS reference RMSE.\n",
  selected_lambda,
  abs(ridge_rmse - ols_rmse),
  abs(ridge_rmse - ols_rmse) / ols_rmse * 100,
  if (ridge_rmse >= ols_rmse) "higher" else "lower"
))
```

### 2025 holdout fit and residual diagnostics

The first figure compares 2025 holdout observations with predictions from the
selected constrained ridge model and an unconstrained OLS reference. Residual
panels show holdout errors against predictions and predictors. With only one
holdout year, year-to-year diagnostics are not applicable; these plots are
descriptive checks rather than formal inference.

```{r holdout-diagnostics, echo=FALSE}
training_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  province = holdout_data$province,
  actual = y_holdout,
  constrained_fitted = best_holdout_predictions,
  constrained_residual = ridge_residuals,
  ols_fitted = ols_holdout_predictions,
  ols_residual = ols_holdout_residuals,
  year = factor(holdout_data$year),
  mean_radiance = holdout_data$mean_radiance,
  population = holdout_data$population,
  pixel_count = holdout_data$pixel_count
)
holdout_predictions_table <- data.frame(
  province = training_diagnostics$province,
  year = holdout_year,
  actual = training_diagnostics$actual,
  ridge_prediction = training_diagnostics$constrained_fitted,
  ridge_residual = training_diagnostics$constrained_residual,
  ols_prediction = training_diagnostics$ols_fitted,
  ols_residual = training_diagnostics$ols_residual
)
write.csv(
  holdout_predictions_table,
  "data/predicted_data/ridge_2025_holdout_predictions.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
print(
  holdout_predictions_table[
    order(abs(holdout_predictions_table$ridge_residual), decreasing = TRUE),
  ],
  row.names = FALSE
)

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

actual_fitted_path <- "figures/ridge_model_2025_holdout_actual_vs_fitted.png"
grDevices::png(actual_fitted_path, width = 1800, height = 1100, res = 160)
```

### 2025 Level-2 Predictions

The fitted model produces an initial prediction for each level-2 unit using the
2025 intercept and the same training-data means and standard deviations used
when fitting the model. Calibrate predictions so the sum of level-2 predicted
GRDP per capita times level-2 population equals the province's 2025 GRDP per
capita times its independently reported province-level population. Convert the
province-level population from thousands to people. Add a common adjustment
\(\delta_j\) to every level-2 prediction within province \(j\):
\[
\tilde y_{ij} = \hat y_{ij} + \delta_j,
\qquad
\delta_j =
\frac{g_jN_j
-\sum_{i\in j}P_{ij}\hat y_{ij}}
{\sum_{i\in j}P_{ij}},
\]
where \(g_j\) is the province's 2025 GRDP per capita and \(P_{ij}\) is the
population of level-2 unit \(i\), and \(N_j\) is the reported total population
of province \(j\). Consequently,
\[
\sum_{i\in j}P_{ij}\tilde y_{ij}
=g_jN_j.
\]

```{r}
if (anyNA(prediction_data$year) || any(prediction_data$year != 2025)) {
  stop("The level-2 prediction dataset must contain only 2025 observations.")
}
if (any(!complete.cases(prediction_data[, c(
  "name", "level_1", "population", "mean_radiance", "pixel_count"
)]))) {
  stop("The level-2 prediction data contains missing required values.")
}
prediction_features <- as.matrix(prediction_data[feature_columns])
if (any(!is.finite(prediction_features))) {
  stop("Level-2 prediction features must be finite.")
}
if (any(prediction_data$population < 0)) {
  stop("Level-2 populations must be finite and non-negative.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(paste(prediction_data$level_1, prediction_data$name, sep = "\r"))) {
  stop("The level-2 prediction data contains duplicate units within a province.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(provincial_grdp_data$province)) {
  stop("Provincial GRDP data contains duplicate province targets.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(provincial_population_data$province)) {
  stop("Provincial population data contains duplicate province totals.")
}

grdp_pc_2025 <- provincial_grdp_data[["2025"]][
  match(prediction_data$level_1, provincial_grdp_data$province)
]
if (anyNA(grdp_pc_2025) || any(!is.finite(grdp_pc_2025))) {
  stop("Missing or non-finite 2025 GRDP-per-capita target for a prediction province.")
}
province_population_2025 <- provincial_population_data[["2025"]][
  match(prediction_data$level_1, provincial_population_data$province)
] * 1000
if (anyNA(province_population_2025) ||
    any(!is.finite(province_population_2025)) ||
    any(province_population_2025 <= 0)) {
  stop("Missing or invalid 2025 population total for a prediction province.")
}

prediction_data$year_factor <- factor(prediction_data$year, levels = years)
scaled_prediction <- scale(
  prediction_data[feature_columns],
  center = feature_means,
  scale = feature_sds
)
prediction_X <- cbind(
  model.matrix(~ 0 + year_factor, data = prediction_data),
  as.matrix(scaled_prediction)
)
if (!identical(colnames(prediction_X), colnames(X))) {
  stop("Prediction design matrix does not match the fitted model.")
}

raw_level2_predictions <- as.vector(prediction_X %*% beta_hat)
province_names <- sort(unique(prediction_data$level_1))
province_adjustments <- setNames(numeric(length(province_names)), province_names)

for (province in province_names) {
  idx <- which(prediction_data$level_1 == province)
  level2_population <- sum(prediction_data$population[idx])
  if (!is.finite(level2_population) || level2_population <= 0) {
    stop(sprintf("Province %s has no positive level-2 population.", province))
  }

  province_index <- match(province, prediction_data$level_1)
  target_total <- grdp_pc_2025[province_index] *
    province_population_2025[province_index]
  raw_total <- sum(
    prediction_data$population[idx] * raw_level2_predictions[idx]
  )
  province_adjustments[[province]] <- (target_total - raw_total) /
    level2_population
}

prediction_data$raw_grdp_per_capita <- raw_level2_predictions
prediction_data$province_adjustment <-
  province_adjustments[prediction_data$level_1]
prediction_data$predicted_grdp_per_capita <-
  prediction_data$raw_grdp_per_capita + prediction_data$province_adjustment
prediction_data$grdp_per_capita_target_2025 <- grdp_pc_2025

province_check <- do.call(rbind, lapply(province_names, function(province) {
  idx <- which(prediction_data$level_1 == province)
  province_index <- match(province, prediction_data$level_1)
  province_population <- province_population_2025[province_index]
  target_total <- prediction_data$grdp_per_capita_target_2025[idx[1]] *
    province_population
  predicted_total <- sum(
    prediction_data$population[idx] *
      prediction_data$predicted_grdp_per_capita[idx]
  )

  data.frame(
    province = province,
    population = province_population,
    level2_population = sum(prediction_data$population[idx]),
    target_grdp_per_capita = prediction_data$grdp_per_capita_target_2025[idx[1]],
    target_total_grdp = target_total,
    predicted_total_grdp = predicted_total,
    difference = predicted_total - target_total
  )
}))

if (any(abs(province_check$difference) >
        1e-8 * pmax(abs(province_check$target_total_grdp), 1))) {
  stop("Calibrated level-2 predictions do not match all provincial GDP targets.")
}

level2_predictions <- data.frame(
  level_2 = prediction_data$name,
  level_1 = prediction_data$level_1,
  year = prediction_data$year,
  population = prediction_data$population,
  province_population_2025 = province_population_2025,
  ridge_lambda = rep(selected_lambda, nrow(prediction_data)),
  raw_grdp_per_capita = prediction_data$raw_grdp_per_capita,
  province_adjustment = prediction_data$province_adjustment,
  predicted_grdp_per_capita = prediction_data$predicted_grdp_per_capita,
  province_grdp_per_capita_target_2025 =
    prediction_data$grdp_per_capita_target_2025
)
prediction_output <- "data/predicted_data/level2_grdp_pc_ridge_predictions.csv"
write.csv(level2_predictions, prediction_output, row.names = FALSE)

print(province_check, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Wrote level-2 predictions to", prediction_output, "\n")
head(level2_predictions)
```
